task_description: HEAVY feature build on the existing Laravel 13 Bansud business permit system: overhaul the applicant portal into a control center. Five parts — (A) dashboard control-center overhaul, (B) Business Profile wiring onto the dormant businesses table, (C) Account/Security Settings, (D) Renewal Reminder R1 (read-only, no application_type column), (E) Help/FAQ page. Implements the approved design cc-design.md iteration 5 without re-deciding architecture. Baseline 154 passed / 519 assertions must stay green; new tests added for Business Profile, Settings, Dashboard stats/fees/renewal, Help, and the payment-flash fix.
